_note: Spec and credit record of the town's music and background loops. toolscli asset ambience reads it; docs/architecture/atmosphere.md explains it. Prompts never name an artist, a song or a label.

sounds.name: StoreRadio
sounds.prompt: Original instrumental late-1980s Eastern European radio pop tune: bright analog synthesizer melody, drum machine with a gated snare, bouncy synth bass, clean chorus electric guitar, light optimistic variety-show feel, mid-tempo around 112 bpm. Instrumental only, no vocals, no speech.
sounds.reason: Only take. Dense steady arrangement with one quieter passage; no silent stretch, loop step 0.07.

sounds.name: PubRadio
sounds.prompt: Original instrumental Central European village pub dance music of the 1980s: accordion lead, clarinet and trumpet melody, tuba bass and brushed snare in a lively polka two-step, warm and a little rough like a small folk dance band playing live. Instrumental only, no vocals, no speech.
sounds.reason: Only take. Steady band texture, one short break mid-track; loop step 0.14.

sounds.name: Furnace
sounds.prompt: Large coal-fired industrial furnace roaring steadily: deep constant fire roar, forced air draught, low rumble, occasional soft crackle of coal. Continuous even level, recorded close, no voices, no music, no metal clanks.
sounds.reason: Only take. Even broadband roar with a strong low band, no events that would mark the loop.

sounds.name: Sawmill
sounds.prompt: Electric circular sawmill running and cutting timber: steady motor whine and a spinning blade ripping through a wooden log, constant level. Outdoors, no voices, no music.
sounds.reason: Only take. Constant motor and blade noise end to end.

sounds.name: Quarry
sounds.prompt: Open stone quarry ambience: a few workers striking rock with pickaxes at irregular intervals, small stones tumbling down, light wind across open ground. Sparse and a little distant, no voices, no engines, no music.
sounds.reason: Only take. Sparse strikes over quiet wind.

sounds.name: Farm
sounds.prompt: Busy village henhouse yard: a dozen hens clucking and scratching continuously, steady and even from start to end, a soft breeze in leaves behind them. Close and constant, no rooster crow, no loud single calls, no voices, no engines, no music.
sounds.reason: Take 2 of 2. Take 1 was near silence with one loud call that would repeat every 18 s; take 2 clucks from start to end. One louder call in its first second is evened out in processing.

sounds.name: Still
sounds.prompt: A copper moonshine still at work: liquid bubbling and gurgling steadily in a pot, a soft hiss of steam, a slow drip into a metal bucket, a small wood fire crackling underneath. Close, continuous, no voices, no music.
sounds.reason: Only take. Regular bubbling with one steam hiss.

sounds.name: PoliceDesk
sounds.prompt: A 1980s police station desk: quiet steady two-way radio static from a small speaker with short bursts of garbled unintelligible dispatcher speech and squelch clicks, and a mechanical typewriter typed slowly nearby. No clear words, no music.
sounds.reason: Only take. Low static with one loud burst at 4 s; evened out in processing, still a retake candidate after listening.

sounds.name: ChopShop
sounds.prompt: Backyard car workshop: an air compressor chugging steadily, a ratchet wrench clicking, an occasional metal tool clinking on concrete, a short hiss of compressed air. Continuous, outdoors, no voices, no music, no engine revving.
sounds.reason: Only take. The compressor cycles on and off four times, tools between.

sounds.name: Square
sounds.prompt: Quiet small-town square in the afternoon: a stone fountain trickling, the indistinct murmur of a few people talking far away, pigeons cooing and a flutter of wings, a bicycle bell once. Calm, no clear words, no traffic, no music.
sounds.reason: Only take. Quiet bed, three bell strokes at the start and one louder event at 15 s.

sounds.name: BankMurmur
sounds.prompt: Quiet interior of a small 1980s bank hall: the low indistinct murmur of two or three people talking far apart, a soft shuffle of shoes on a stone floor, paper rustling, room tone. Calm, even level, no clear words, no music, no phone ringing.
sounds.reason: First take. Low murmur bed with gentle swells, no clear words; loop step 0.02.

sounds.name: BankTill
sounds.prompt: An old wooden wall clock ticking and tocking clearly and steadily once per second throughout, in a quiet room. Once in the middle a metal cash drawer slides open with a short bell ring and coins, then slides shut. No voices, no music.
sounds.reason: Second take; the first was two loud events in silence. A clock tick every second for 15.7 s with a drawer and coins at 9 to 12 s; very quiet, so it is levelled (even). Loop step 0.01.

sounds.name: HospitalEquipment
sounds.prompt: Electronic ECG heart monitor beep repeating steadily once per second, with a medical machine motor humming and an air pump softly pulsing under it. Hospital bedside, clean close recording.
sounds.reason: Third take; the first two were near silence (peaks under -47 dB). A steady machine hum with two tonal lines, no alarm; the beep did not come through, so it is hum only.

sounds.name: HospitalWard
sounds.prompt: Hospital ward room tone: a constant low air-conditioning hum, a nurse and a patient murmuring softly in the next room, footsteps on linoleum passing in a corridor, a trolley wheel squeaking now and then, a door closing. Clearly audible, calm, no clear words, no alarms, no music.
sounds.reason: Second take; the first kept 2 s above the silence floor. Quiet room tone with footsteps and a door at 10 and 12.5 s, levelled; weakest of the batch, listen to it.

sounds.name: PayphoneLine
sounds.prompt: Old telephone handset held to the ear: a faint steady dial tone line hum with a little electrical buzz and static, very quiet. No voices, no ringing, no music.
sounds.reason: First take. Steady low line hum with electrical buzz, no tone events; loop step 0.53 is hum, not an event.

sounds.name: FuelPump
sounds.prompt: Roadside fuel pump dispensing: a steady electric pump motor hum with the gurgle of fuel flowing through a hose. Outdoors, constant level, no voices, no music, no engine.
sounds.reason: First take. Even motor hum with a gurgle; loop step 0.09.

sounds.name: VanIdle
sounds.prompt: A small diesel delivery van engine idling at a kerb: a steady low diesel tick-over with a slight rattle and a faint exhaust rumble. Outdoors, constant level, no revving, no voices, no music.
sounds.reason: First take. Even diesel tick-over, no revving; loop step 0.32 is engine texture.
